cs.t: Man I love e-ink devices so much. My Onyx Boox Note Air is one of the nicest and useful devices I have ever owned. I absolutely love it and their open platform. (I even ditched my Kindle oasis for the Poke3) I always regarded e-ink as a soon-to-be (or already) obsolete technology and while that might still be true, I absolutely love it for reading and writing. There is currently nothing better.
I recently ditched my kindle for an Onyx Boox Note Air. No regrets.
cs.th: Kindle E-Readers cannot be turned off anymore
